episode.method: Fold episode-block bootstrap (20000 draws) + conditional temporal-edge permutation (20000 draws) on the real portfolio engine; 98h linkage.

temporal_edge_permutation.method: conditional permutation: crash bars redrawn from the real RSI(21)<20 census with observed per-symbol multiplicity preserved; exact validated portfolio replay
limitations: Distinct null configurations fewer than the preregistered draw floor; resampled with replacement to reach the floor (standard Monte-Carlo permutation). Every draw is a real null configuration.

placebo.method: Deterministic seeded full-portfolio placebo (2000 subsets); preserves gates/sizing/cap/occupancy/hedge on the fold slice.
limitations: CROSS-VENUE MEXC fold 2025; NOT Hyperliquid performance evidence.
